intro: Government agencies and critical infrastructure anchor the cisa-kev tag archive, which spans 20 articles published between 2026-04-19 and 2026-10-21. Coverage also reaches technology and enterprise environments across the United States, Global, North America, EU, and Europe. Flax Typhoon appears among the tracked threat actors. The archive documents CVE-2015-3306, CVE-2026-20079, and CVE-2026-48907, each rated CVSS 10, alongside CVE-2023-49105 and CVE-2025-39682 at CVSS 9.8. Severity across the collection comprises 6 high, 8 critical, and 2 medium entries, reflecting sustained attention to vulnerabilities added to the known exploited catalog.
